categories.label: DJ Speakers
categories.description: High-performance speakers designed for DJs and live events.
categories.overview: StudioMax supplies the full Studio Max DJ speaker line in 12", 15", and 18" sizes. Select a size tab to browse every model and contact us for datasheets and pricing.

categories.label: PA Speakers
categories.description: Portable and install PA solutions including powered cubes and column speakers.
categories.overview: StudioMax supplies Almax Audio PA speakers for speech, announcements, and background music. Browse Cube 30 and metal column models below—contact us for pricing and integration support across India.

categories.label: Microphone stands
categories.description: Table and floor microphone stands for stage, studio, and speech.
categories.overview: StudioMax supplies the full Almax Audio microphone stand range—table and floor models for vocals, instruments, and presentations. Select a style tab to browse all models and enquire for pricing across India.

categories.label: Trumpet & Reflex Horn
categories.description: Trumpet and reflex horns for focused projection in PA and install systems.
categories.overview: StudioMax supplies the Almax Audio trumpet and reflex horn line in 12″, 18″, and 22″ formats. Browse all models below and contact us for pricing and OEM support across India.

categories.label: HF Tweeter
categories.description: High-frequency drivers engineered for detail and longevity.
categories.overview: High-frequency tweeters and compression drivers engineered for detail, efficiency, and long service life. Compare every HF model in our range below, including impedance, power ratings, and application notes.

categories.label: Driver Unit & Diaphragm
categories.description: Driver units and diaphragms for custom speaker builds.
categories.overview: Driver units and diaphragms for custom speaker builds, repairs, and OEM production. The full StudioMax driver catalogue is listed below with specifications for each model so you can match replacements or new designs accurately.

categories.label: Wires & Cables
categories.description: Professional cables for reliable signal and power.
categories.overview: Signal and power cables selected for low noise, secure connectors, and professional install practice. Every cable model in our range is listed below with length, connector, and use-case details plus enquiry options.

categories.label: Microphones
categories.description: Microphones for vocals, instruments, and speech.
categories.overview: Dynamic and vocal microphones for stage, speech, and instrument capture. See the complete StudioMax microphone range below—each model with description, specs, pricing, and availability.

categories.label: Accessories
categories.description: Essential hardware for mounting, connectivity, and installs.
categories.overview: Mounting hardware, connectors, and install essentials that complete a professional audio deployment. Browse all accessory models below with specifications and direct enquiry for trade and bulk pricing.
